items.name: Grab (GrabFood)
items.what: Order food from Phuket restaurants to your villa or hotel, in the same Grab app you use for rides. The app is in English.
items.where: Phuket and Koh Samui (both on Grab's list of areas). Koh Phangan is not on the list, so use Delivery KPG there.
items.setup: Use the same Grab account as for rides. Add your card and save your villa or hotel address with a clear map pin.
items.cost: Menu prices plus a delivery fee based on distance. You can pick Saver, Standard or Priority delivery.
tips: Pay by card in the app, or pick Cash at checkout ('Payment method', then 'Cash'). Keep small notes for cash orders.
You can order up to 2 days ahead, or choose Pickup and collect the food yourself to skip the delivery fee.
For a villa, add a note for the rider: villa name, gate and a landmark. Keep your phone on when the rider is close.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. App Store id647268330 opens in the US, GB and TH stores ('Grab: Taxi Ride, Food Delivery', GRABTAXI HOLDINGS); Google Play com.grabtaxi.passenger ('Grab - Taxi & Food Delivery', Grab Holdings, updated 29 Sep 2026). items.name: LINE MAN
items.what: Big Thai food delivery app with 700,000+ restaurants, including many small local places. It translates menus and rider chat into English.
items.where: Phuket, and Koh Samui (LINE MAN says it covers all 77 provinces). Koh Phangan: not confirmed.
items.setup: LINE MAN logs in with a LINE account. Make a LINE account first (SMS code to your phone), then log in to LINE MAN and save your address.
items.cost: Free app. The store text says delivery fees start at 0 baht with promotions.
tips: Try Grab first. Use LINE MAN when a small local place you want is not on Grab.
Many discounts are for Thai bank cards. We could not confirm that foreign cards work, so check the payment options before you order.
Rider chat is translated: you write in English and the rider sees Thai.

links.label: English menus and rider chat (LINE MAN news)

items.name: Delivery KPG
items.what: Food delivery on Koh Phangan, where Grab is not listed: 300+ restaurants, cafés and shops, in the app or on the website. Food takes about 45 to 60 minutes.
items.where: Koh Phangan only. The delivery range depends on the restaurant you pick.
items.setup: Sign up with your WhatsApp number (country code, no '+' or spaces). The code comes by WhatsApp. You can also order on delivery-kpg.com.
items.cost: Minimum order 200 THB. The delivery fee depends on your location.
tips: Pay the driver in cash or by Thai QR code. The FAQ says card payment is only planned, so keep cash.
Open 08:00 to 23:45. You can cancel only within 5 minutes of ordering.
Help is on WhatsApp: +66 63 678 2760. Store reviews mention some long waits, so do not order at the last minute.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. items.name: Wongnai
items.what: Big Thai restaurant review site and app: ratings, photos, menus and prices from Thai diners. Use it as a second opinion next to Google Maps.
items.where: Restaurant listings across Thailand, including Phuket.
items.setup: On iPhone the app is only in the Thai App Store, so use the website. Android has a store listing.
items.cost: Free.
tips: The iPhone app is in the Thai App Store only. A foreign Apple ID cannot download it.
For English, open wongnai.com/?locale=en.
Many reviews are in Thai. Let your browser translate the page.

items.name: DICE
items.what: Ticket app for Circoloco. Dice tickets live only in the app: no PDF, no email ticket, no print. At the door you show a QR code from the app.
items.where: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (Phang Nga, about 1 hour north of Kamala), Sat 9, 16 and 23 Jan. The app works anywhere with internet.
items.setup: Install DICE and make the account with your phone number and your name as in your passport. Buy, then open the ticket once so it is saved offline.
items.cost: Free app. Dice shows the full price with fees. Circoloco from EUR 107.99 (16 Oct 2026).
tips: The QR appears on the day, about 2 hours before doors: open the ticket tab, pick the event, tap 'Activate QR Code'. Do not screenshot it.
Buying for the group? Use 'Send ticket to a friend' before activation, if the event allows it. Friends need a Dice account with the number in your contacts.
After activation you cannot send or return a ticket. If you all arrive together, you can show all tickets on one phone.
Circoloco on Dice: max 6 tickets per order, sales end 12:00 on Sat 23 Jan, refund only if the event is moved or cancelled.
Dice says 18+, Ticketmelon says 20+. Plan for 20+ and bring your real passport: Dice says a photo of ID will likely not be accepted.
Logged out? When you log in again in the app, Dice sends the 4-digit code to your email, so it also works with a Thai SIM.
Sold out? Use the Dice wait list if the organiser turns it on. Never buy Dice tickets from strangers.

items.name: Ticketmelon
items.what: Thai ticket site and app. It sells Circoloco in baht (Dice sells it in euros). Your QR ticket is in the app and in a PDF sent by email.
items.where: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (9, 16 and 23 Jan) and many other Thai events. Online, anywhere.
items.setup: Make an account with your email, or with Google, Facebook or Apple. Install the app to have the QR on your phone, and keep the email PDF as a backup.
items.cost: Free account. Fees are added at checkout. Pay by card, PromptPay or wallets like TrueMoney and LINE Pay.
tips: At the door, show the QR in the app ('Tickets', then tap the event poster) or the PDF. Staff may check your ID and give you a wristband.
Circoloco on Ticketmelon is set to 20+. Bring your passport.
Each QR works once. Do not post it online. Ticketmelon does not support resale, so buy only on Ticketmelon.
Names usually cannot be changed. Most events do not check that the name matches your ID, unless the event page says so.
All sales are final. Refunds only if the event is cancelled or postponed, and fees are not refunded.

items.name: Megatix (megatix.in.th)
items.what: Ticket website for most of your nights: Café del Mar shows, DnB Allstars, OXA, Jungle Experience and Hollystone. The e-ticket is a PDF with a QR code, sent by email.
items.where: Phuket: Café del Mar (Kamala), DnB Allstars (Chalong). Koh Phangan: OXA, Jungle Experience, Hollystone. Online, anywhere.
items.setup: No app needed. Make a free account on megatix.in.th at home and buy early: the cheaper first releases sell out, then prices go up.
items.cost: Free account. A booking fee is added (3.5% on DnB Allstars THB tickets). Pay by card, PromptPay QR or TrueMoney.
tips: The 'Megatix' app in the stores is a ticket scanner for organisers. You do not need it.
The PDF comes by email right after you pay. Lost it? Log in, click your name at the top, choose 'Tickets' and download it again.
Show the QR on your phone and zoom in so the whole code is on screen. Each ticket lets one person in, once.
Use megatix.in.th. The address megatix.co.th is a parked domain, not Megatix.
Café del Mar, Hollystone and DnB Allstars are 20+. DnB Allstars checks ID: non-Thais need a passport.
The ticket name is the buyer's account. DnB Allstars allows transfers only by its name-change process, up to 7 days before 22 Jan.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. megatix.in.th FAQ: PDF e-ticket by email, download again under your name, zoom in at entry, ticket name is the buyer. DnB Allstars THB page terms: strictly 20+, passport for non-Thais, QR e-ticket, name-change rule, card, PromptPay QR, TrueMoney. DnB official site sells only through Megatix. The store apps called Megatix (iOS id1085614750, Android com.megatix.android) are scanners for event staff. Café del Mar Argy page: 20+. megatix.co.th shows a parked domain page.

items.name: Eventpop
items.what: Thai ticket app that Waterfall Festival uses. The e-ticket comes by email and sits in the app's Wallet, with your name and a QR code.
items.where: Waterfall Festival, Ban Tai, Koh Phangan (also sold on Entrix). Online, anywhere.
items.setup: Sign up with email (or Facebook) and verify your email: without it the QR is hidden. Use your name as in your passport.
items.cost: Free app. Pay by credit or debit card, bank transfer or bill payment.
tips: At the gate, show the e-ticket in the app or printed. Some organisers also check your passport.
Some tickets hide the QR behind a countdown until close to the event. Open the app with internet on the day.
To give a ticket away (if the event allows it): on the website, 'Tickets', 'View Detail', 'Transfer Ticket'. The friend has 48 hours to accept.
Keep the QR and reference code private. Anyone with them can enter as you.

links.label: Eventpop: download and use your e-ticket

items.name: Entrix (entrix.vip)
items.what: Ticket website for Koh Phangan parties, run by Phangan Events (the phangan.events team): Bambu Sunday Sessions, Waterfall Festival and Retro Mountain nights. QR ticket by email.
items.where: Koh Phangan: Bambu (Haad Yuan), Waterfall Festival (Ban Tai), Retro Mountain. A few Phuket and Samui events too. Web only, no app.
items.setup: No app. Buy on entrix.vip with your email. The ticket arrives by email within a minute, and the QR is also in 'My account' when you sign in.
items.cost: Prices include the service fee (Bambu from 320 THB online, Oct 2026). Pay by card, PromptPay or PayPal, in baht.
tips: Each ticket has its own single-use QR. Buying for friends? All QRs go to your account, so you can check everyone in together.
Do not share screenshots of the QR. Once it is scanned, it cannot be used again.
Sales are final unless the event page says otherwise. Ticket Protection at checkout is optional, and service fees are never refunded.
The age rule is on each event page under 'Practical'. Bambu and Waterfall show 21+.
Some listings only link to other shops (Megatix, Vibez, Get In). Then you buy there.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. entrix.vip home, help, terms (updated 1 Jun 2026; run by Phangan Events Co. Ltd) and the Bambu and Waterfall event pages read. No Entrix ticket app exists: the App Store app called 'ENTRIX' is a parking app by another company.

items.name: RA Guide (Resident Advisor)
items.what: Resident Advisor's app: find club nights and underground parties, follow DJs and clubs so their new events show up for you, and buy RA tickets.
items.where: Clubs in Phuket (Café del Mar, Armania, Shelter), Koh Phangan (Unclave, Retro Mountain, Sabaii Bay) and Samui (Sound Club). Online, anywhere.
items.setup: Log in with an RA account (or Apple on iPhone). Set the location to Thailand, 'All', then follow the clubs and DJs you like.
items.cost: Free app. Ticket prices depend on the event.
tips: RA files Phuket and Koh Phangan clubs under Thailand 'All'. Its 'Phuket' area had no listings in Oct 2026, so do not rely on it.
The ticket barcode appears only 24 hours before the event. Show it in the app; on iPhone it also works offline.
Bring your passport. RA says valid ID is needed at most events.
RA tickets cannot be transferred, but you can change the name once in the app, up to 24 hours before. Resale works only for sold-out events.
Small parties appear late. In the last week, also check the crews' Instagram (Shelter, Courage Bar, SUB).
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. items.name: Vibez.io
items.what: Ticket shop and app used by Sacred Moon Phangan for Lost Jungle (Parvati Day & Night, 9 to 11 Jan). Your ticket is a QR code in your Vibez account.
items.where: Lost Jungle, Koh Phangan, 9 to 11 Jan. Buy on web.vibez.io or in the app.
items.setup: Sign up with your phone number. The 4-digit code comes by SMS or WhatsApp; choose WhatsApp if SMS to your number is slow.
items.cost: Free app.
tips: Buying for friends? You can assign each ticket to a phone number, and Vibez sends that person a link to their ticket.
Find your QR under 'Tickets'. You can also download the QR image.
Some events are for members only and ask you to join the organiser's community first.

items.name: GETIN (Get In)
items.what: Ticket site and app used by Utopia, the jungle rave at Than Sadet on Koh Phangan. Tickets live in the GETIN app, with a waiting list and transfers to friends.
items.where: Utopia, Than Sadet, Koh Phangan. January dates were not out on 16 Oct 2026. Online, anywhere.
items.setup: Only if you go to Utopia. Install GETIN and make the account before you buy, so the ticket shows on your phone.
items.cost: Free app. Utopia prices are in US dollars (Oct 2026 rounds: USD 65 to 97, door USD 103).
tips: Utopia's Oct 2026 page says 18+ and 'Bring ID'. Bring your passport.
Cannot go? The app lets you join a waiting list or send the ticket to a friend.
Prices rise with each round, so buy early if you are sure.

items.name: Telegram (Phangan Party Guide)
items.what: Follow the 'Phangan Party Guide' channel on Telegram. It posts each day's Koh Phangan parties with times, line-ups and ticket links, in English.
items.where: Koh Phangan parties. Works anywhere with internet.
items.setup: Install Telegram and sign up with your phone number (code by SMS). Then open t.me/phanganparty and join the channel.
items.cost: Free.
tips: No Telegram account? Read the channel in a browser at t.me/s/phanganparty.
Posts link to the phangan.events calendar and often to Entrix tickets (Entrix is run by Phangan Events).
It posts many times a day (about 6,800 followers in Oct 2026). Mute it and check it once a day.
For Phuket nights, follow the crews on Instagram (Shelter, Courage Bar, SUB). They post their parties there.

items.name: Agoda
items.what: Hotel and villa booking app from an Asia-based company (offices in Singapore and Thailand, part of Booking Holdings). Many Thai hotels, guesthouses and villas. Compare with Booking.com.
items.where: All of Thailand: Kamala, Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Nai Yang near the airport.
items.setup: Make an account with your passport name and set the currency to baht (THB).
items.cost: Free app. The shown price is often without tax and service fee, so check the total before you pay.
tips: Each rate shows how you pay: 'Pay now', 'Book now, pay later' or 'Pay at the hotel'. Not every hotel offers all three.
Pay later: Agoda charges your card closer to check-in. Pay at the hotel: you pay in baht at check-in, and a card may be needed to hold the room.
Many cheap rates are non-refundable. Read the cancellation line before you book.
Neither Agoda nor Booking.com is always cheaper. Compare the same room and dates on both, and on the hotel's own site.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. App Store id440676901 (Agoda Company Pte. Ltd.) in the US, GB and TH stores, v14.38.0 (14 Oct 2026); Google Play com.agoda.mobile.consumer (agoda.com, 14 Oct 2026). items.name: Booking.com
items.what: Hotel booking app with free cancellation on most rooms. Many hotels take the payment themselves, at check-in or check-out. Good to compare with Agoda.
items.where: All of Thailand: Kamala, Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Nai Yang near the airport.
items.setup: Make an account and keep your bookings in the app. You can message the hotel there.
items.cost: Free app. Booking.com says it charges no booking or credit card fees.
tips: Your confirmation says who charges your card and when. Usually the hotel charges at check-in or check-out; some ask for prepayment.
With no prepayment, the hotel may still put a test hold on your card. It is returned later.
Free cancellation ends at a deadline. After it, the hotel's fee applies.
Taxes and service charges may show apart until the last step. Compare the final total with Agoda.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. App Store id367003839 (Booking.com B.V.) in the US, GB and TH stores, v70.6 (15 Oct 2026); Google Play com.booking (16 Oct 2026). items.name: Hostelworld
items.what: Hostel booking app with a social side for your solo days: chats with people in your hostel and city, traveller profiles, and 'Linkups', meet-ups like bar crawls, dinners and tours.
items.where: Hostels in Phuket (the social ones in this guide are in Patong) and on Koh Phangan. City chats for Phuket.
items.setup: Install the app, make a profile and book a bed. No hostel booking? Buy a Social Pass in Profile Settings to join the city chats.
items.cost: Free app. Social Pass: EUR 4.99 a week or EUR 9.99 a month, a one-time payment, not a subscription (Sep 2026).
tips: Hostelworld's site says chats open 7 days before check-in, and its App Store text says 14 days. Linkups open 14 days before.
Staying in a hotel near the airport? A 1-week Social Pass opens the Phuket city chat and meet-ups without a hostel booking.
Some Linkups cost money, and some hostels ask you to sign up at reception. Read the description.
Your bookings are saved in the app for offline use.
items.verification: Checked 16 Oct 2026. App Store id348890820 (Hostelworld.Com Limited) in the US, GB and TH stores, v13.94.1 (5 Oct 2026); Google Play com.hostelworld.app (29 Sep 2026). items.name: Klook
items.what: Book tours, boat trips, airport transfers and a tourist SIM with pickup at Phuket airport. Vouchers are in the app and can be saved for offline use.
items.where: Phuket: tours, boat trips, HKT airport transfers and SIM pickup at the airport. Check listings for Koh Samui and Koh Phangan.
items.setup: Make an account and add your card. Book the airport car before you fly and add your flight number.
items.cost: Free app.

Compare the same tour on GetYourGuide before you book.

result.notes: Food: after foodpanda left (23 May 2025), GrabFood and LINE MAN are the two big delivery apps. Grab's own area list names Phuket, Phang Nga and Surat Thani/Samui but not Koh Phangan; on Koh Phangan the local service is Delivery KPG (WhatsApp sign-up, cash or Thai QR, 08:00-23:45). No laundry or massage app worth installing was found for Phuket. How tickets arrive: DICE in the app only (QR on the day, about 2 h before doors; transfers only before activation); Ticketmelon in the app or as an email PDF; Megatix as an email PDF (no buyer app; the store app is a scanner); Eventpop by email and in the app Wallet (verify your email; some QRs show only near the event); Entrix by email and in 'My account' (web only; the App Store 'ENTRIX' is a parking app); RA in the app (barcode 24 h before); Vibez as a QR in your account (SMS or WhatsApp login); GETIN in its app (Utopia). items.name: Wise
items.what: Card and app that pays abroad at close to the real (mid-market) rate. Use it for card payments in malls, hotels and Grab, and for cash from Thai ATMs.
items.where: Anywhere Visa or Mastercard is taken: Phuket, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Phuket airport. Cash works at any Thai bank ATM, also on Koh Phangan.
items.cost: Free account. Changing to THB cost about 0.6-0.75% from GBP, EUR or USD (Wise price check, 16 Oct 2026). ATM: free up to 250 GBP/EUR/USD a month, then 2.69% (UK, EEA) or 1.95 USD + 1.95% (US).
items.setup: Open the account, verify your ID and order the plastic card early, because delivery takes some days. Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Wallet. Top up before you fly.
tips: Thai ATMs add their own fee: 250 baht with Visa, 350 baht with Mastercard (Kasikorn, SCB, Krungsri, GSB, 2026). Take out a large amount each time.
Wise cards from the EEA are Visa, so you pay the 250 baht ATM fee. The network depends on the country of your card, so check yours.
If the ATM or card machine offers your home currency, say no and choose THB. The Wise rate is better.
The Wise app can scan QR codes at shops with the Alipay+ logo (about 1.8-1.9% in total, Oct 2026). Thai PromptPay QR is still 'coming soon'.
Wise can also send baht to a Thai bank account, for example for a villa or tour deposit.

tips: Standard plan: exchanges from Friday 17:00 to Sunday 18:00 New York time cost 1% more. Change to THB before Friday evening.
Premium, Metal and Ultra plans have no weekend fee and a higher free ATM amount.
The Thai ATM fee (250 baht Visa, 350 baht Mastercard) comes on top. Take out large amounts.
If a card machine offers your home currency, say no and pay in THB.

To pay: tap Scan & Pay, scan the QR code, type the amount and enter your PIN.

items.what: The main chat app in Thailand, used by over 80% of people. Hotels, drivers, shops, money changers and some clubs answer on LINE. Many have a LINE Official Account.

Links like lin.ee/... or line.me/R/ti/p/@... open the account in LINE, where you can add it.

result.notes: 1) All five guide claims check out. Two small additions are worth making: the Tourist Police app needs mobile data or Wi-Fi, and when you keep the home SIM on for SMS codes, turn off its data roaming. 2) LINE sign-up: the task assumed an SMS code. LINE Help Center says users outside Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Taiwan and Thailand can no longer sign up with a phone number (from version 13.11.0); they use 'Continue with Apple' or 'Continue with Google'. 3) Connectivity section: AIS also has a 30-day tourist plan for 1,199 baht with eSIM (and 60 days 1,599 as SIM only), not only True. True prices 15 days 699 and 30 days 1,199 confirmed. 4) THIM (Thai Immigration Bureau, Royal Thai Police, App Store id6759272559, Google Play th.go.immigration.thim) is a new arrival app; TAT (11 Jun 2026) says it is an optional pilot and does not replace the TDAC. True gives THIM users a free 1-day SIM at airport counters incl. HKT. This belongs in the travel section. 5) Wise PromptPay QR scanning and transfers launched in 2026 only for Wise accounts registered in Thailand; for foreign Wise accounts PromptPay QR is 'coming soon' and only Alipay+ QR works. 6) TAGTHAi Easy Pay: the KBank sheet (June 2026) asks to link the app before 22 Jul 2026, while the TAGTHAi app (14 Oct 2026) still advertises Easy Pay with pre-registration. Re-check in December 2026. 7) ATM fees: the 250 (Visa) / 350 (Mastercard) baht rule is confirmed in official tables of Kasikorn, SCB, Krungsri and GSB. I found no 2026 tables for Bangkok Bank or Krungthai. Krungsri also lists 200 baht for a Visa cash withdrawal at its branch or exchange office counter (EDC); SCB lists 180 baht for Visa/Mastercard credit cards at its branches. 8) Revolut and TrueMoney sites block automated reading; their figures come from their own help-page text in search results, so check in the app. 9) If someone in the group has cards from Russian banks: Phuket Insider says they do not work in Thailand (sanctions), except UnionPay cards from Rosselkhozbank. Airalo and TrueMoney are not in the Russian App Store; the other iOS apps listed were found in the US and GB stores. 10) No official Thai travel-advice app exists; use your own government's advice (e.g. UK FCDO pages with email alerts), the Tourist Police app alerts and TAT 1672. result.notes: Checked on 16 Oct 2026. All 10 store apps here are listed in the US, UK, German and Thai App Stores (iTunes lookup), so a foreign Apple ID can download them; none is Thai-store-only. Main points for the guide: (1) Bolt's Thai licence expired in May 2026 and it runs on a temporary permit (MGR Online, 18 Jul 2026); no decision found by mid-Oct, so re-check in late December. (2) No ride app works on Koh Phangan; Grab works on Koh Samui and in all of Phang Nga (Natai) since Mar 2025. (3) Grab's official HKT directions: international arrivals go out at Exit 8 and walk toward the domestic terminal; domestic arrivals exit at Gate 1 and turn right to the Grab booth. Bolt and inDrive pick up outside the airport gate. No separate Grab airport fee was found. (4) Lomprayah's own terms (14 May 2026) say be at the Lomprayah counter 60 minutes before departure; the guide's 'How to book boats' says 30-45 minutes, so update it. (5) The Lomprayah, Seatran and Haad Rin Queen booking systems already sell 19-23 Jan 2027 trips and their times match the guide; several Lomprayah departures showed only 2-5 online seats. (6) The 12Go claim is fixed: the phone e-ticket is enough only when the trip has the e-ticket sign. (7) Official airport limousine prices (Oct 2026): car Kamala 750, Patong 800, Nai Yang 400 baht; minibus for up to 10 people Kamala 1,300. Not confirmed: Bolt and inDrive on Koh Samui, Maxim driver numbers in Phuket, whether GrabBike shows in every part of Phuket, and the Grab Travel Pass price for Thailand. Fare ranges differ between 2026 guides (for example Patong to Kata: 200-280 Grab in one, 350-500 in another), so keep them as ranges.

items.name: Grab (GrabFood)
items.what: Order food from Phuket restaurants to your villa or hotel, in the same Grab app you use for rides. The app works in English.
items.where: Phuket and Koh Samui (Grab's list names Phuket and 'Surat Thani/Samui'). Koh Phangan is not on the list, and local guides say Grab does not run there, so use Delivery KPG.
items.setup: Use the same Grab account as for rides. Add your card and save your villa or hotel address with an exact map pin.
items.cost: Menu prices plus a delivery fee based on distance. You can pick Saver, Standard or Priority delivery.
tips: Pay by card in the app, or tap 'Payment method', then 'Cash' at checkout. Paying with a big note? Tell the rider in the chat first.
You can order from up to 4 restaurants at the same time. Handy for a big group with different tastes.
You can order up to 2 days ahead ('Order for later'), or choose Pickup and collect the food yourself to save the delivery fee.
For a villa, add a note for the rider: villa name, gate and a landmark. Keep your phone on when the rider is close.

items.name: LINE MAN
items.what: Big Thai food delivery app with 700,000+ restaurants, including many small local places. It translates menus into English, and your English chat with the rider reaches them in Thai.
items.where: Phuket. LINE MAN says it serves all 77 provinces, but Koh Samui and Koh Phangan coverage is not confirmed.
items.setup: The store text says you log in with your LINE account. Make a LINE account at home (SMS code to your phone), then open LINE MAN and save your address.
items.cost: Free app. The store text says delivery fees start at 0 baht with promotions.
tips: Try Grab first. Use LINE MAN when a small local place you want is not on Grab.
Many discounts are for Thai bank cards. We could not confirm that foreign cards work, so check the payment options before you order.
Rider chat is translated: you write in English and the rider sees Thai. There are English chat stickers too.

items.what: Food delivery on Koh Phangan, where Grab does not run: 300+ restaurants, cafés and shops, in the app or on the website. Delivery takes about 45 to 60 minutes.

tips: Pay the driver in cash or by Thai QR code. The FAQ says card payment is only planned, so keep cash.
Open 08:00 to 23:45. You can cancel only within 5 minutes, and not once the restaurant starts cooking.
Help is on WhatsApp: +66 63 678 2760. Store reviews (2025-2026) mention app bugs and some orders cancelled without notice.

items.name: DICE
items.what: Ticket app for Circoloco. Dice tickets live only in the app: no PDF, no email ticket, no print. At the door you show a QR code from the app.
items.where: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (Phang Nga, about 1 hour north of Kamala), Sat 9, 16 and 23 Jan, 15:00 to 03:00. The app works anywhere with internet.
items.setup: Install DICE and sign up with your phone number and your full name as in your passport. Dice uses this name to match your ID at the door.
items.cost: Free app. Dice shows the full price with fees. Circoloco from EUR 107.99 (16 Oct 2026).
tips: The QR appears on the day, about 2 hours before the start: open the ticket tab, pick the event, tap 'Activate QR Code'. Do not screenshot it.
Buying for the group? Use 'Send ticket to a friend' before activation, if the event allows it. Friends need a Dice account with the number in your contacts.
After activation you cannot send or return a ticket. If you all arrive together, you can show all tickets on one phone.
Circoloco on Dice is one listing for all three dates: max 6 tickets, refund only if the event is moved or cancelled, and not in the last 24 hours.
Dice says 18+, Ticketmelon says 20+. Plan for 20+ and bring your real passport: Dice says a photo of ID will likely not be accepted.
Logged out? When you log in again in the app, Dice sends the 4-digit code to your email, so it also works with a Thai SIM.
Phone lost or broken? Message Dice before the event. Most venues keep a Dice door list, where you show ID that matches your account name.
Sold out? Use the Dice wait list if the organiser turns it on. Never buy Dice tickets from strangers.

items.name: Ticketmelon
items.what: Thai ticket site and app. It sells Circoloco in baht (Dice sells it in euros). Your QR ticket is in the app and in a PDF sent by email.
items.where: Circoloco at Baba Beach Club Natai (9, 16 and 23 Jan) and many other Thai events. Online, anywhere.
items.setup: Make an account with your email, or with Google, Facebook or Apple. Install the app to have the QR on your phone, and keep the email PDF as a backup.
items.cost: Free account. Fees are added at checkout. For Circoloco you can pay by card, PromptPay, TrueMoney or LINE Pay.
tips: At the door, show the QR in the app ('Tickets', then tap the event poster) or the PDF. Staff may check your ID and give you a wristband.
Circoloco on Ticketmelon is set to 20+. Bring your passport.
Ticketmelon says you may screenshot the QR, so save it in your photos too. Each QR works once, so never post it online.
Ticketmelon does not support resale. Buy only on Ticketmelon or Dice, never from strangers.
Names usually cannot be changed. Most events do not check that the name matches your ID, unless the event page says so.
All sales are final. Refunds only if the event is cancelled or postponed, and fees are not refunded.

items.name: Megatix (megatix.in.th)
items.what: Ticket website for most of your nights: Café del Mar shows, DnB Allstars, OXA, Jungle Experience and Hollystone. The e-ticket is a PDF with a QR code, sent by email.
items.where: Phuket: Café del Mar (Kamala), DnB Allstars (Azulea, Chalong, 22 to 24 Jan). Koh Phangan: OXA, Jungle Experience, Hollystone. Online, anywhere.
items.setup: No app needed. Make a free account on megatix.in.th at home and buy early: the cheaper first releases sell out, then prices go up.
items.cost: Free account. A service fee is added at checkout. DnB Allstars lists card, PromptPay QR and TrueMoney as payment.
tips: The 'Megatix' app in the stores is a ticket scanner for organisers. You do not need it.
The PDF comes by email right after you pay. Lost it? Log in, click your name at the top, choose 'Tickets' and download it again.
Show the QR on your phone and zoom in so the whole code is on screen. Each ticket lets one person in, once.
Use megatix.in.th. The address megatix.co.th is a parked domain, not Megatix.
Café del Mar, Hollystone, Jungle Experience and DnB Allstars pages say 20+, OXA pages say 18+. DnB Allstars checks ID: non-Thais need a passport.
The ticket name is the buyer's account. DnB Allstars allows transfers only by its name-change process, up to 7 days before 22 Jan.

tips: Show the e-ticket in the app or printed, together with your passport. Eventpop says the ID check depends on the organiser.

items.name: Entrix (entrix.vip)

tips: Each ticket has its own single-use QR. Buying for friends? All QRs go to your account, so you can check everyone in together.
Do not share screenshots of the QR. Once it is scanned, it cannot be used again.

The age rule is on each event page under 'Practical'. Bambu and Waterfall show 21+, so bring your passport.
Some listings only link to other shops (Megatix, Vibez, GETIN). Then you buy there.

items.name: Agoda
items.what: Southeast Asian booking app for hotels, villas and guesthouses, part of Booking Holdings (like Booking.com). Compare the two for each stay.
items.where: All of Thailand: Kamala, Ban Tai on Koh Phangan, Nai Yang near the airport.
items.setup: Make an account with your passport name and set the currency to baht (THB).

items.what: Hostel booking app with a social side for your solo days: chats with people in your hostel and city, traveller profiles, and 'Linkups', meet-ups like bar crawls, dinners and tours.

items.name: Wise
items.what: Card and app that pays abroad at the mid-market rate plus a small fee. Use it for card payments in malls, hotels and Grab, and for cash from Thai ATMs.
items.where: Anywhere Visa or Mastercard is taken: Phuket, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Phuket airport. Cash works at any Thai bank ATM, also on Koh Phangan.
items.cost: Free account. Card 7 GBP or 7 EUR (9 USD in the US). Changing to THB costs about 0.6-0.75% from GBP, EUR or USD (Wise prices, 16 Oct 2026). ATM: free up to 250 GBP/EUR/USD a month, then 2.69% (UK, Ireland) or 1.95 USD + 1.95% (US).
items.setup: Open the account, verify your ID and order the plastic card early, because delivery takes some days. Add the card to Apple Pay or Google Wallet. Top up before you fly.
tips: Thai ATMs add their own fee: 250 baht with Visa, 350 baht with Mastercard (Kasikorn, SCB, Krungsri, GSB, 2026). Take out larger amounts.
Wise cards from Ireland and the EEA are Visa, so the Thai ATM fee is 250 baht. The network depends on the country of your card, so check yours.
If the ATM or card machine offers your home currency, say no and choose THB. The Wise rate is better.
The Wise app can pay Alipay+ QR codes (about 1.8-1.9% in total, Oct 2026), but not Thai PromptPay QR yet. Not for Wise accounts from the US, Canada or Japan.
Wise can also send baht to a Thai bank account, for example for a villa or tour deposit.
items.verification: 16 Oct 2026: Wise card fee pages for UK, IE and US (ATM free to 250, then 2.69% or 1.95 USD + 1.95%; card 7 GBP, 7 EUR, 9 USD). items.cost: Free Standard plan (UK and EU, Oct 2026): exchange up to 1,000 GBP or EUR a month with no extra fee, then 1%; 1% extra at weekends; free ATM up to 200 GBP or EUR or 5 withdrawals a month, then 2%.

items.name: Grab: Taxi Ride, Food Delivery
items.what: Main ride app in Phuket. Cars and motorbike taxis, with the price shown before you book. 2026 guides say it is the only ride app with an official pickup point at Phuket airport.
items.where: Phuket: whole island, incl. the airport. Natai (Phang Nga): yes, since Mar 2025. Koh Samui: yes. Koh Phangan: no, there are no or almost no Grab drivers.
items.setup: Install at home and sign up with your own phone number. Grab sends a code by SMS, so do it while your home SIM works. Add a credit or debit card. No Thai SIM needed.
items.cost: Free app. Fares shown before you book. Advance Booking adds a fee, about 50 baht for GrabCar (2026 guide).
tips: Airport, international arrivals: go out at Exit 8 and walk toward the domestic terminal to the Grab pickup point. Domestic: exit at Gate 1, turn right to the Grab booth.
Ride types at Phuket airport: JustGrab (nearest car or taxi), GrabCar, GrabCar Premium, GrabBike, and GrabSUV or GrabCar Plus for more space and luggage.
Advance Booking: book from 90 days up to 75 minutes before pickup, at a fixed price. Use it for the ride to the airport on 26 Jan.
Safety: tap 'Share my ride' so a friend can follow your car live. The emergency button alerts help. The in-app chat translates your messages.
GrabBike is a motorbike taxi for one person. Legal riders have yellow number plates. You must wear the helmet.
2026 guides: about 600-950 baht from the airport to Patong and 250-380 from Patong to Kamala. Prices go up at busy times and in heavy rain.
Grab works in all of Phang Nga since Mar 2025, so you can book rides to and from Baba Beach Club in Natai. Pay by card or cash.
Foreign visitors can buy a Grab Travel Pass for Thailand in the app (Account > Subscription). The vouchers last 4 weeks from the day you buy. Check the price first.

items.where: Phuket. At Phuket airport only drop-offs at the terminal; for pickups you walk out of the airport gate. Koh Phangan: no. Koh Samui and Natai: not confirmed.
items.setup: Install at home and sign up with your phone number and the code it sends. Add a card, but also carry cash.
items.cost: Free app. Fares shown before you book.
tips: 2026 guides say Bolt is often 5-30% cheaper than Grab in Phuket. Check both apps.
Bolt drivers cannot pick up at the airport terminal. They wait outside the airport gate, a 5-10 minute walk with bags.
Bolt's Thai licence ran out in May 2026. In July it still ran on a temporary permit while the Land Transport Department decides. Keep Grab ready.
In early Sep 2026 Bolt briefly paused rides in Thailand to update driver records. Check that the app finds cars before you rely on it.
Card payment works, but many Phuket drivers prefer cash. Carry small notes.
Phuket ride types: Economy, Bolt, XL and Van (up to 6 people), and Taxi. You can schedule a ride from 30 minutes to 90 days ahead.
Safety: the Emergency Assist button, and 'Share location' sends your car and live position to a friend.

items.name: inDrive: rides at your price
items.what: Ride app where you offer your own price and drivers accept or counter. Often the cheapest, but fewer drivers and mostly cash.
items.where: Phuket, best in Rawai, Chalong, Kata and central Patong. No pickups inside Phuket airport. Koh Phangan: no. Koh Samui: not confirmed.
items.setup: Optional. Install at home and sign up with your phone number. Carry cash.
items.cost: Free app. You offer the fare.
tips: Type your price; drivers accept it or ask for more. Choose a driver by rating, car and arrival time.
It works in Phuket in 2026, but has fewer drivers than Grab. Outside the busy areas nobody may take your offer.
Most drivers want cash, and cancellations before pickup are common. Use Grab when time matters.
Drivers cannot pick you up inside Phuket airport.

items.where: Phuket and Koh Samui (Maxim's city list). Not on Koh Phangan. Airport pickups: not confirmed.

items.cost: Free app. Price shown before you order.

items.name: Phuket airport taxi and limousine counters
items.what: Official counters at Phuket airport: fixed-price limousine cars and minibuses, metered taxis and shared minibuses. Easy for the big group on 8 Jan.
items.where: Phuket airport (HKT), both terminals, right after the arrivals exit. Rides to all of Phuket, and to Natai and other provinces.
items.setup: Optional: book a fixed-price car or a minibus for the group online before the flight.
items.cost: Car (up to 3): Nai Yang 400, Kamala 750, Patong 800 baht. Minibus (up to 10): Kamala 1,300. Taxi: meter + 100 baht.
tips: Phuket Airport Limousine has counters at the domestic exit Gate 1 and the international exit Gate 2. Prices are fixed and shown before you pay.
Prices on its website (Oct 2026), car for up to 3: Phuket Town 650, Kamala 750, Patong 800, Kata 1,000 baht. SUV for 4 (07:00-18:00 only): Kamala 1,100.
Minibus for 5-10 people: Nai Yang 600, Kamala 1,300, Patong 1,400 baht. Pay online by card, PromptPay or e-wallet, or at the counter.
Metered taxis wait outside the terminal at the 'Metered Taxi' sign. You pay the meter plus a 100-baht airport fee.
Shared minibus (P.M.K. counter), per person: 150 baht to Phuket Town, 180 to Patong, 200 to Kata or Rawai (official airport list).
EVme electric VIP taxis: counter in the domestic terminal, level 1, Public Transport Center. Meter from 150 baht plus the 100-baht airport fee.

items.name: Phuket Smart Bus
items.what: Cheap bus along the west coast: Airport - Surin - Kamala - Patong - Karon - Kata - Rawai for 100 baht. Live bus map on the website. No app needed.
items.where: Phuket only. Route 1 starts outside the domestic terminal at HKT (Exit 3) and stops in Kamala. No stop in Nai Yang. Not on Koh Samui or Koh Phangan.
items.setup: Nothing to install. Bookmark the live map (phuketsmartbus.com/tracking). Have a contactless card or small notes.
items.cost: Route 1: 100 baht flat. Route 2: 50 baht. Dragon Line: free. Route 1 pass: 299 baht for 1 day, 799 for 7 days.
tips: From the airport every 30 minutes, 08:15-23:30. Last bus from Rawai to the airport 19:30. Times change with traffic.
Airport to Kamala takes about 50 minutes. Kamala to the airport: first bus about 06:15, last about 20:35 (Big C Kamala), about 1 hour 15 minutes.
At the airport: go out at Exit 3 of the domestic terminal, turn left and follow the public transport walkway to the blue Smart Bus sign.
Pay on board: tap a contactless Visa, Mastercard or JCB card, Apple Pay or Google Pay, or pay cash. The QR is for Thai bank apps (PromptPay).
Route 2 runs Bus Terminal 2 - Phuket Town - Patong (50 baht). The Dragon Line in Old Town is free.
Help: LINE @pksb or WhatsApp +66 86 306 1257.
The Android app called 'Phuket Smart Bus' is unofficial. Use the website instead.

items.name: Koh Phangan songthaews and taxis (no app)
items.what: Ride apps do not work reliably on Koh Phangan. You use shared songthaew pickup trucks, private taxis and taxi boats. Always agree the price before you get in.
items.where: Koh Phangan only: Thong Sala pier, Ban Tai, Haad Rin and the party venues.
items.setup: Nothing to install. Ask your Ban Tai hotel for a driver's WhatsApp or LINE before you arrive.
items.cost: Shared truck about 200 baht per person from Thong Sala to Haad Rin (2026 guides); more late at night and on party nights.
tips: Do not count on Grab, Bolt or inDrive here: there are no or almost no drivers.
Songthaews wait at Thong Sala pier, mostly when boats arrive. Tell the driver where you go and agree the price per person.
Save the number of a good driver on day one, or ask your hotel to call one. Private taxis cost more than shared trucks.
Trucks get rare after dark. On Full Moon night they run through the night, but prices go up and they fill up fast. Plan the ride home.
Taxi boats serve beaches on the north and east coast.
Easier arrival: Lomprayah and Seatran sell boat tickets with a van to your Koh Phangan hotel (not Thong Nai Pan), 670-700 baht from Samui airport.
items.verification: 16 Oct 2026: maratnomad.com (updated 20 Mar 2026) says ride apps do not operate there; fullmoonparty.guide says coverage is patchy and unreliable; goasia.cc (updated 16 Oct 2026) covers night service, Full Moon prices and water taxis. Hotel-van fares from the Lomprayah and Seatran booking systems for 19 and 23 Jan 2027.

items.name: Lomprayah
items.what: Big ferry company for Samui and Koh Phangan. Van + fast boat from Samui airport to Thong Sala, and back. Book on the website; there is no app.
items.where: Samui airport (van to Bangrak pier) and Bangrak pier to Thong Sala pier on Koh Phangan. Also bus + boat tickets from Phuket.
items.setup: Book on lomprayah.com at home. Save the e-ticket email on your phone so you can open it offline.
items.cost: Samui airport to Thong Sala 500 baht. Thong Sala to Bangrak pier 350 baht. Samui airport to or from your Koh Phangan hotel 700 baht (booking site, Jan 2027).
tips: 19 Jan 2027, Samui airport to Thong Sala: about every hour from 07:30 to 15:00, last at 17:00. The trip takes about 1 hour.
23 Jan 2027, Thong Sala to Samui airport: 07:30, 10:45, 12:30, 13:40, 14:00 and later. The 10:45 is at the airport at 11:30, so it fits an afternoon flight.
Hotel ticket: a van picks you up at your Koh Phangan hotel (not Thong Nai Pan). On 23 Jan the 09:30 pickup is at Samui airport at 11:30. 700 baht.
On 16 Oct 2026 some boats showed only 2-5 seats left online. Book early for the full-moon week.
Be at the Lomprayah counter 60 minutes before departure to confirm your trip (Lomprayah terms).
Tickets cannot be refunded. One date change is free if you email at least 2 days before. 20 kg of luggage is free; more costs 200 baht.
Lost the email? Open 'My bookings' on lomprayah.com. Enter your email and ticket code, or get a 6-digit code by email, to show your ticket.
Help: phone or WhatsApp 065 350 9040 (08:00-20:00), LINE @pnd0714w.

Thong Sala to Samui airport on 23 Jan 2027: 10:30 and 11:00 (at the airport 12:00 or 12:30), then 16:00 and 16:45.

items.name: Haad Rin Queen
items.what: Boat straight from its own pier in Bangrak on Samui to Haad Rin, the Full Moon beach. Slow ferry or fast speedboat. Book on its website.
items.where: Its own pier in Bangrak on Koh Samui, close to the airport, and Haad Rin pier on Koh Phangan.
items.setup: Optional. Book on haadrinqueen.com (Thai or English) or buy at the pier.
items.cost: Ferry 200 baht, speedboat 500 baht (booking site, Jan 2027).
tips: Haad Rin to Samui on 19 and 23 Jan 2027: ferry 09:30 and 16:00 (50 min), speedboat 12:30 and 17:00 (25 min).
Samui to Haad Rin: ferry 10:30 and 17:00, speedboat 15:00 and 18:30. The 18:30 is the latest boat to Koh Phangan we found on these days.
Online booking closes 30 minutes before each boat.

items.name: 12Go Train Bus Ferry Flight
items.what: Booking app for ferries, buses, vans, transfers and flights in Thailand, incl. Phuket to Koh Phangan routes. Good to compare times and operators.

Pay by card (3D Secure), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PromptPay. If something goes wrong on the trip, call the phone number on your voucher.

result.notes: Checked on 16 Oct 2026. All 11 store apps (incl. MAPS.ME) are listed in the US, UK and Thai App Stores, so a foreign Apple ID can download them; none is Thai-store-only. Google Play titles and publishers match. Key points: (1) Bolt: licence expired May 2026, temporary permit (MGR Online, 18 Jul 2026), brief pause in early Sep 2026 (The Nation, 5 Sep 2026); no final decision found. Re-check in late December. (2) From 1 Oct 2026 the government enforces that all app drivers have a public licence and a properly registered vehicle (Thailand Business News, 30 Sep 2026). (3) No ride app works reliably on Koh Phangan. Lomprayah (700 baht) and Seatran (670 baht) sell Samui airport to Koh Phangan hotel tickets with a van, which avoids pier taxis. (4) Lomprayah, Seatran and Haad Rin Queen times for 19 and 23 Jan 2027 were re-pulled from their own booking systems and match. Lomprayah online seats were as low as 2-5 on some boats. (5) The '15:05 flight' in the old Lomprayah tip could not be verified; third-party schedules list Samui-Phuket departures at 14:30 and 15:25 (summer 2026), so re-check the booked time.
